item.title: 2XKO Season 1 Battle Pass revealed with 3 different tiers
item.description: <p>It only took like seven years to get here, but <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/06/2xko-official-console-release-date/">2XKO's full release</a> is finally right around the corner.</p> <p>And now we're getting a much better picture of what's going to be available in the Season 1 launch of 2XKO next week.</p>

item.title: Broski releases new tier list for Street Fighter 6 Season 3 with one character ranked 'not even good enough for D'
item.description: <p>Although it may not feel like it, <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Figher 6</a> is still technically right in the middle of its third season with many months left to go.</p> <p>Top player <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@BroskiFGC">Broski</a> recently put together a new tier list for Street Fighter 6 Season 3 where he's got some interesting placements on the top and bottom.</p>

item.title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves Season 2 reveals Nightmare Geese, Blue Mary, Krauser, Kim Jae Hoon and 2 mystery characters
item.description: <p>Although the first season of <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/apr/21/fatal-fury-city-wolves-review/">Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves</a> just wrapped last month with <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/nov/25/mr-big-trailer-ffcotw-launch/">Mr. Big</a>, there's even bigger things coming to the game in the new year.</p> <p>SNK has now officially revealed the Season 2 release date for Fatal Fury as well as the new DLC lineup — well, for most of the characters at least.</p>

item.title: What implications do Alex's heel turn in Street Fighter 6 have for his character development and story direction?
item.description: <p>Back when Alex originally got announced for Street Fighter 6's third season, I <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/jun/19/alex-protagonist-potential-sf6/">wrote a piece</a> about his story and where it might lead, which included speculation of him making a heel turn in the ring.</p> <p>Well, <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/08/alex-teaser-trailer-sf6/">last week</a> we got to see that this is exactly where Alex's persona as a wrestler has been heading, with him being

item.title: Invincible VS variant covers from the comic book artists revealed, only available for one system and certain retailers
item.description: <p>After <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/12/2xko-season-1-time/">2XKO</a>, <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/invincible-vs/">Invincible VS</a> is the next fighting game in line to release this year, and fans can get a little bonus if they want something more connected to the comics.</p> <p>Skybound Games has now revealed a couple of special variant covers for Invincible VS though they'll be limited in where you can get them and for what system.</p>

item.title: 2XKO changes plans from 5 seasons in 2026 to only 3
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/06/2xko-official-console-release-date/">2XKO</a> is now only days away from finally launching in earnest, but it seems as though not everything is set in stone behind the scenes.</p> <p>Riot Games has just released a new update blog, which details some changes being made to their content plans for the first year.</p>

item.title: Raging Demon tier list ranks every iconic Super use from Akuma, Evil Ryu, Dark Sakura, and all characters who've used one
item.description: <p>The Raging Demon (or Shun Goku Satsu) has arguably been the most iconic fighting game Super for over 30 years, but not all of them are created equally.</p> <p>As for which Raging Demons are the best / worst of all time, we now have some rankings that try to break them all down.</p>

item.title: Season 2 balance changes teased for Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves show off new combos and more interesting things you can do

item.title: CyGames Cup 2026 live stream ft. Gamera, Tororo, Kojicoco, Shio, ZangiefDream, Osakana-san, Shou-san, Fukunaga, A1r0ke, Elsa, Incendiate and more
item.description: <p>This weekend will be seeing the annual CyGames Cup happening for its 2026 edition and it'll be in Tokyo, Japan.</p> <p>Notable players participating include GS|Gamera, IBSG|Tororo, PAR|Kojicoco, Shio, ZangiefDream, Osakana-san, Shou-san, Fukunaga, FC|A1r0ke, Kanme|Elsa, DEUS|Incendiate, Barutorec, BlueSkyGuyBSG, IMM|RQ, Debagame, Sanchi, Tahichi, Kosame and more.</p>

item.title: Fatal Fury's AI trailer controversy ignites discourse and pushback about the technology's use across the fighting game community
